    x, y, n = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())
    b = 0
    min_ratio = float('inf')
    a = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        val = min((i * x) % y, y - (i * x) % y)
        ratio = val / i
        if min_ratio > ratio:
            min_ratio = ratio
            b = i
            if (i * x) % y <= y - (i * x) % y:
                a = (i * x) // y
            else:
                a = (i * x) // y + 1
    print(f"{a}/{b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
